A1.justification: Local reading commands stalled without returning document content, including attempts to read the PDF skill and extract both PDFs. The papers' identity, completeness, and appendices could not be verified. This is an access failure, not evidence of missing content.

before.justification: No content from v2.pdf was available to verify whether it reports original empirical results.

after.justification: No content from v3.pdf was available to verify whether it reports original empirical results.

M1.justification: Neither method description could be inspected, so procedural or model changes cannot be established.

E1.justification: The datasets, tasks, and evaluated scenarios in both PDFs were inaccessible.

E2.justification: Comparator participation could not be checked against the experiments in either PDF.

E3.justification: Evaluation protocols and settings could not be read or matched between versions.

E4.justification: Ablations, robustness tests, and supplementary analyses could not be inspected in either version.

E5.justification: Run counts, seed information, and uncertainty reporting were unavailable for comparison.

E6.justification: Tables, figures, and reported findings could not be read, preventing verification of result changes or comparable settings.

T1.justification: Mathematical definitions, assumptions, derivations, and proofs could not be inspected.

C1.justification: The abstracts, introductions, and conclusions were unavailable, so changes in core claims cannot be determined.

C2.justification: Interpretations, applicability boundaries, and limitations could not be compared.

D1.justification: Implementation details and reproducibility disclosures could not be inspected in either paper or its appendices.

R1.justification: Citations and research positioning were inaccessible, preventing comparison of prior-work coverage.

P1.justification: Neither document's language or structure could be inspected, so rewriting and reorganization remain unresolved.

P2.justification: No rendered pages or readable displays were available to compare figures, tables, captions, or layout.

improvement.justification: The local reading tools returned no content from either PDF. Without before-and-after evidence from the papers and appendices, the direction or significance of any overall quality change cannot be assessed.
